items.title: The tensor functor with a dg bimodule is a functor of dg categories
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dga.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-tensor at source lines 4944-4963: for a ring R, dg algebras (A,d) and (B,d) over R and a dg (A,B)-bimodule N, the construction sending a dg A-module M to M tensor over A with N is a functor of dg categories, and hence induces functors on the module category and on the homotopy category. The proof at source lines 4965-4995 is the sign computation that makes the functor compatible with differentials: it recalls the differential of a homogeneous A-module homomorphism f of degree n, writes the differential of f tensor the identity of N in the same shape, applies both sides to a decomposable tensor x tensor y with x and y homogeneous, expands the two terms using the Leibniz-type rules for the tensor product differential, and observes that the two copies of the signed term f(x) tensor d_N(y) cancel, leaving exactly d(f)(x) tensor y. The whole content is that cancellation, which needs the sign (-1)^(n + deg x) to be produced by the tensor-product differential in both terms; the statement records none of it. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
